My dear [Miss Medhurst](/person/988)
I did hope to have put in this sonnet of yours in time for Ascension day, but I could not manage it, so I can only send you the proof and thank you for your kindness to [Emmeline Spratt](/person/1358), who after her visit to you wrote the happiest letter she had written at all since leaving home[^1]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: In fact the sonnet waited a year to be published in MP (May 1874).

Blanche Medhurst\'s social work had brought her in touch with Emmeline, the niece of CMY\'s maid Harriet Spratt.
